hints.tr: `while head:` içinde önce `nxt = head.next`, sonra `head.next = prev`.
hints.en: Inside `while head:`, first `nxt = head.next`, then `head.next = prev`.

hints.tr: Sonra `prev = head` ve `head = nxt`; döngü bitince `return prev`.
hints.en: Then `prev = head` and `head = nxt`; after the loop `return prev`.

hint.en: Turn the links with a `while` loop.
